correctness.rationale: The fixed-symmetry reduction of the two-community equal-recovery reversal-payoff system is an invariant 3D flow with conserved c=logit(n)−logit(m). In logits u,v, u’=w(u)[1−2M_c(v)], v’=(1+theta)sigma(u)−1. Exact F’=( (1+theta)sigma(u)−1 )/w(u), G_c’=2M_c−1 yield a conserved strictly convex coercive Hamiltonian and smooth periodic ovals for E>0. End slopes F’(−∞)=−1/b,F’(+∞)=theta/a,G’(±∞)=±1 give u turning point lengths bE and aE/theta; the central upper/lower branch speed yields 2(1−epsilon)(1+1/theta)E, while two turning caps take O(epsilon E+1) by monotone v. Sending E→∞ then epsilon→0 proves T_c(E)/E→2(1+1/theta) in original physical time for fixed a,b,theta>0,0<delta<1,c real. I independently verified F’ and F’’ symbolic identities. No extension to transverse 5D or moving parameters is implied.
